brief.name: Receiver operating window
brief.purpose: Bounded receiving interval with low-margin and overload markers described in text
brief.learningIntent: T06; more optical power can exceed a receiver bound
brief.plannedMethod: Actual OpenAI base imagery with preserved original output; all exact labels/values in semantic UI, with manual diagrams/edits truthfully recorded

binding.alt: Two brass stops enclose the receiver band. A hatched strip at its low end and a bolt above the high end distinguish reserve and overload.
binding.caption: Receiver limits in this exercise are −14 through −1 dBm inclusive with at least 2 dB reserve above sensitivity. At −13 dBm the reserve is only 1 dB. A separate 0 dBm observation exceeds the maximum by 1 dB. Compare the actual reading and freshness recorded alongside this guide.

conversion: Scale the full uncropped frame with Lanczos and encode RGB WebP at quality 88, method 6. No retouching or labels in the derivative.
